changelog: Merged critic candidate rules into [When to Segment]: added a concise 'Cautions and exceptions' list that groups coordination, complement-taking words, ambiguous verbs, exclusive/contrastive scope markers, copular + article constructions, pronoun attachments to verbals, postmodifier-dependent noun heads, 'called'/identifying phrases, destination/locative phrases, and complements that change verb frame as reasons to wait or rank lower. This implements all candidate_rules without adding new prohibitions.

Refined [Priority Rules]: added an explicit instruction to lower confidence for boundaries immediately before or after commas when the following phrase is a locative or restrictive modifier, and clarified lower-ranking guidance for ambiguous verbs, agreement-sensitive finite verbs after coordination/punctuation, and other cases where complements determine final sense. This organizes the critic suggestions into the ranking system rather than forbidding positions.
